Needs human review to address dispute. / task_completion 2: Caller asked why EMI is 4500 vs 4000; agent never explained or offered to check, only repeated it lacks info and offered human. Caller refused human and asked to note 4000; agent did not confirm 4000 but also did not resolve the discrepancy. / conversation_flow 2: Agent repeated the same 'no info, offer human' line multiple times. Also had long silences and caller repeatedly asked 'are you there?' indicating poor flow. / empathy_tone 3: Polite and neutral, but did not acknowledge caller's frustration or time pressure. Slightly scripted. / escalation 2: Agent offered human transfer multiple times after caller explicitly declined. Should have stopped offering and instead offered callback or other resolution.
